notification.from: created_at; read status does not matter

conversation.from: last non-system message; new message renews deadline

policy.physicalDatabaseCleanup: hourly, on the next successful unlocked sweep; not exact-deadline deletion

security.newSqlVerification: actual PostgreSQL tests and source review

limitations: Minimal schema and synthetic auth roles; not live Supabase policies/triggers.
One PostgreSQL connection verifies send-before-cleanup and cleanup-before-send ordering; independent-connection lock races remain unverified.
Cron SQL registration API is simulated; actual pg_cron extension/timer execution requires production acceptance.
Only production exists; live cron jobs, full Supabase schema/policies and independent-connection races remain acceptance checks.
Browser storage is physically pruned when the application opens or its active deadline timer executes, not while the application is closed.
Uploaded objects in the existing public Storage bucket are not physically garbage-collected by this package.
Existing eligible production records become deletion candidates on the first scheduled sweep; deleted data requires a DB backup to recover.
No new public performance or database capacity claim; previous lab reports remain baselines.
